title: frangula californica subsp. tomentella
intro: Frangula californica subsp. tomentella, commonly known as California buckthorn or California coffeeberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rhamnaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include digestive aid, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Frangula californica subsp. tomentella include stimulating bowel movements, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, such as aloe-emodin and chrysophanic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
